limitations: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md natively from version 2.1.277, but only when no CLAUDE.md exists in the project or a parent directory.
Installed instructions do not verify runtime access, hook execution or permissions.
Claude-specific hooks and permissions are not transferred.
Run project preconditions explicitly and verify discovery in the actual host.

limitations.worktrees: The harness declares no host-native worktree isolation for Codex: the session opens the worktree with git and hands the delegate its path.

limitations: Kimi Code reads AGENTS.md from the project tree; the documented .agents/skills discovery and the instruction file do not prove runtime activation.

This profile writes portable files and the sf-<tier> tier agents; it does not install Kimi, write ~/.kimi-code or select a model: a tier agent runs on the model alias its route names, which you declare in your own [secondary_model.models] pool (sf agents route prints the entries to paste).

limitations.hooks: Kimi Code reads its hooks from the user's own configuration only, never from the project, so the harness installs no guard or capture hook for it; the CLI's own guards still refuse an escape hatch.
limitations.worktrees: The harness declares no host-native worktree isolation for Kimi Code: the session opens the worktree with git and hands the delegate its path.

limitations.routing: The harness ships no routing candidates for Gemini CLI, so sf agents route cannot name a tier for it.
limitations.tierAgents: The harness writes no Gemini CLI tier agent.
limitations.hooks: No Gemini CLI guard or capture hook is installed by the harness.
limitations.worktrees: The harness declares no host-native worktree isolation for Gemini CLI: the session opens the worktree with git and hands the delegate its path.

limitations.routing: The harness ships no routing candidates for Qwen Code, so sf agents route cannot name a tier for it.
